# Bootstrap fixtures

`synthetic_webgameconfig.json` is a synthetic compatibility fixture generated from the Phase 7 development model. It was not captured from the retired official service and is not yet proven acceptable to the original client.

`synthetic_webgameconfig.json` remains the Phase 7 transport-only fixture. Never
relabel it as original behavior.

`recovered_minimal_webgameconfig.json` and
`recovered_minimal_server_address.json` were constructed from static X2 2.4
client evidence. They were not captured from retired official infrastructure.
The field names and parser data flow are confirmed; all concrete endpoint values
are local compatibility values. Unknown operational fields are intentionally
excluded.
